explication: Pulse is an offline Windows diagnostics desktop app. Users inspect a live event timeline, system health, and hardware/software inventory, then review explanations or export reports. The tree shows the Windows app launcher and a substantial PulseService implementation, but not the app’s main UI sources. The service entry point and inventory collection are sampled; several other service links and UI-to-service wiring are therefore left unverified rather than inferred.
